name: Celestial Ascent
source:
Impossible powers on one side, inexplicable encounters on the other. 

What happens when these two disparate events come to a head? 

[From [url=https://radiocabel.itch.io/celestial-ascent]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一方面是不可思议的力量，另一方面是无法解释的遭遇。

当这两个不同的事件达到紧要关头时会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://radiocabel.itch.io/celestial-ascent]Itch.io[/url]]
